{{Quote|Relic from a bygone era, it still can conjure up images and feelings... mine is the heritage of a Jedi Knight.|Corran Horn regarding Nejaa's lightsaber|<ref name="TBW" />}}
'''Nejaa Halcyon's lightsaber''' was a single [[Color/Legends|silver-bladed]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] wielded by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Nejaa Halcyon]], and later his grandson [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] after he found it in the [[Galactic Museum/Legends|Galactic Museum]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
===Usage under Nejaa Halcyon===
This lightsaber was created by Nejaa Halcyon as early as 60 BBY<ref name="TKT" /> and was used by him when he was assigned to protect the [[Intergalactic Communications Center]] on [[Praesitlyn/Legends|Praesitlyn]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="JT">''[[Jedi Trial]]''</ref> Later as a newly appointed [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], Nejaa Halcyon used his lightsaber to fight alongside fellow Jedi [[Ylenic It'kla]] against the [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Nikkos Tyris]] on the planet [[Susevfi]]. It was during this battle that Nejaa was [[Death/Legends|felled]], and his lightsaber was recovered by Ylenic and placed within the [[Galactic Museum/Legends|Galactic Museum]] alongside a picture of him and his [[Padawan]], [[Hal Horn|Valin Halcyon]], to memorialize the brave Jedi General.<ref name="IJ">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>

===Usage under Corran Horn===
Decades later in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], Nejaa Halcyon's lightsaber was recovered by Corran Horn, Nejaa's grandson and [[Ace/Legends|ace]] pilot of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]]. Corran happened upon the lightsaber after he escaped from the ''[[Lusankya (prison)|Lusankya]]'' [[Prison/Legends|prison]] and used a stolen luxury [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] to escape, which coincidentally took him to the Galactic Museum. After [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] revealed that the lightsaber belonged to his grandfather, Corran was given permission to keep the lightsaber as a sign of his inheritance.<ref name="TKT" /> 

From then on, Corran Horn used his grandfather's lightsaber during his many missions with Rogue Squadron, including the [[Bacta War]]<ref name="TBW" /> and the [[Hegemony theater|Ciutric Hegemony Campaign]].<ref name="IR">''[[X-Wing: Isard's Revenge]]''</ref> He also used his grandfather's lightsaber when he was recruited to join Luke Skywalker's academy in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]]. He particularly used it when he participated in [[Kam Solusar]]'s lightsaber training drills and in a [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|sparring match]] against Luke Skywalker. However, not long after Corran left the [[Jedi Praxeum]] to rescue his kidnapped wife, [[Mirax Terrik Horn]], he replaced Nejaa's lightsaber with a [[Corran Horn's lightsaber|newly constructed lightsaber of his own]] that he fashioned on the planet [[Courkrus]].<ref name="IJ" />
